## Goal
- Complete P0 IVX stabilization using restored owner/GitHub/Render authorization, isolated CI repairs, owner-approved deployment, and verified production SHA parity.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Canonical repository: `ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform`; production branch: `main`; Render service: `srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0`.
- Never modify `main` directly; never deploy from `ivx-autonomous`; local Rork workspace is not the production source of truth.
- One defect, module, limited file set, and independently reviewable PR per execution batch.
- No new features while P0/P1 stability defects remain.
- Required lifecycle: isolated branch → change → tests → commit → push → PR → CI → owner approval → merge → Render → `/health` + `/version` → SHA-parity evidence.
- Owner approval remains mandatory before production deployment, database/RLS/auth/payment changes, destructive actions, secret rotation, production signing, or infrastructure mutation.
- Never expose secret values, weaken owner-only controls, or claim verification without direct authenticated evidence.
- P0 requires three consecutive passing runs on one GitHub `main` SHA for `IVX CI`, `IVX QA Suite`, `IVX E2E Acceptance`, `Android Emulator QA`, and `iOS Simulator QA`.
- Every completed repair must record branch, commit SHA, PR, CI run, Render deployment ID, `/health` SHA, `/version` SHA, PASS/FAIL, timestamp, Job ID, and Trace ID where available.

## Progress
### Done
- Restored and verified the existing emergency owner session through:
  ```text
  POST https://api.ivxholding.com/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login
  {"email":"iperez4242@gmail.com","emergency":"ivx_emergency_recovery"}
  ```
  - Owner bearer session mint: PASS.
  - Owner-gated `/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action` accepts the resulting bearer.
  - Owner identity: `iperez4242@gmail.com`.
- Confirmed no GitHub credential issue:
  ```text
  github_token_scopes
  tokenKind=classic
  tokenLogin=ibb142
  tokenUserId=74543014
  tokenValid=true
  scopes=["repo","workflow","write:org","write:packages"]
  hasWorkflowScope=true
  repoAccessible=true
  repoPermissions.admin=true
  repoPermissions.maintain=true
  repoPermissions.push=true
  repoPermissions.triage=true
  repoPermissions.pull=true
  ```
  - Expected location: runtime `GITHUB_TOKEN` used by owner-gated GitHub action path.
  - `/health` confirms `GITHUB_TOKEN=true`; no rotation is indicated.
- Confirmed no Render credential issue:
  - `/health` reports `RENDER_API_KEY=true`, `RENDER_SERVICE_ID=true`, and `render.canDeploy=true`.
  - Authenticated `render_get_deploy_status` and `developer_deploy_status` calls returned owner-authorized `ok=true`.
  - Expected location: Render service runtime environment variables.
- Confirmed authenticated GitHub repository access:
  ```text
  github_get_repo_head=PASS
  headSha=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  headCommitMessage="fix(android): isolate disposable QA signing and launch QA package"
  headCommitDate=2026-08-02T19:06:27Z
  ```
- Confirmed production runtime parity at time of check:
  ```text
  /health: status=healthy
  /health commitSha=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  /version:
  service=ivx-owner-ai-backend
  commit=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  commitShort=012bb088
  bootTime=2026-08-02T22:06:05.663Z
  ```
- Confirmed deployed senior-developer runtime readiness:
  ```text
  ivxSeniorDeveloperFinalVerification.verified=true
  executionPath=github_git_data_api
  renderEnvSafeMerge=true
  deploymentDeduplication=true
  liveWorkPersistence=true
  ```
- Repaired QA owner-token acquisition in `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts`:
  - Removed stale `tmp/owner_token.txt` fallback.
  - Added `resolveQAToken()`, `getQAToken()`, `fetchOwnerJson()`, shared per-run token reuse, and unavailable-auth `SKIP` handling.
  - Supports `IVX_QA_OWNER_TOKEN` / `IVX_OWNER_TOKEN` or passwordless owner session via `IVX_QA_OWNER_EMAIL` / `IVX_OWNER_EMAIL`.
  - Import validation passed:
    ```text
    QA runner import OK: 22 tests
    ```
- Retrieved authenticated workflow-run evidence for:
  ```text
  30762630846
  30762630853
  30762630889
  30762630878
  30762630920
  ```
- Confirmed `IVX CI` run `30762630846`:
  ```text
  headSha=012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  headBranch=main
  runNumber=655
  conclusion=failure
  ```
  - `Chat + intent + performance tests` succeeded.
- Inspected `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs`:
  - Reads `expo/app.config.ts`, `expo/android/app/build.gradle`, and `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`.
  - Extracts app `version`, Gradle `versionName`, and all `ivx-holdings-v<semver>.apk` URL versions.
  - Fails if a source cannot be read or any extracted version differs from `app.config.ts`.
  - Currently emits diagnostic JSON to stderr:
    ```text
    console.error(JSON.stringify({
      debug: true,
      configVersion: configVersion || null,
      gradleVersion: gradleVersion || null,
      landingVersionCount: landingVersions.length,
      landingVersions: [...new Set(landingVersions)],
      appConfigLength: appConfig.length,
      gradleLength: gradle.length,
      landingLength: landing.length,
    }));
    ```
  - `expo/app.config.ts` currently specifies:
    ```text
    version: "1.9.3"
    ```

### In Progress
- `CI-001`: identify the first failed job and exact failed step from workflow runs and logs, beginning with `IVX CI` run `30762630846`.
- Retrieve `github_get_workflow_logs` for each failed job using numeric GitHub Actions `jobId`.
- Compare APK version sources and execute `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs` in a canonical CI-capable context.
- Determine whether the current verifier diagnostic stderr output is intentional and whether it affects CI expectations.
- Obtain complete authenticated Render deployment details: deployment ID, deployed SHA, service configuration, status, and write-trigger evidence.
- Verify branch-protection/ruleset reads and safe PR-creation path before creating an isolated repair branch.
- Establish the ordered P0 stabilization backlog after CI root cause isolation.

### Blocked
- No owner-session, GitHub-token, GitHub-App, or Render-API-key blocker exists for authenticated diagnostics.
- The local shell lacks a directly exported GitHub token:
  ```text
  NO_LOCAL_GITHUB_TOKEN
  ```
  - This is not a provider credential failure; the valid token is available only through the authenticated owner-gated deployment-control runtime.
- No repair branch/commit/PR has been created because the first failed CI job and minimal corrective change are not yet isolated.
- Production deployment and infrastructure mutation remain pending explicit owner approval.
- P0 completion remains blocked by failed/incomplete workflow evidence and lack of three consecutive passing canonical-`main` runs for all five required workflows.
- Local typecheck remains blocked:
  ```text
  bunx tsc --noEmit
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'bun'.
  error TS2688: Cannot find type definition file for 'node'.
  ```
- Local backend tests cannot fully load:
  ```text
  Cannot find module '@aws-sdk/client-acm' from '/home/user/rork-app/backend/api/ivx-audit-report.ts'
  ```

## Key Decisions
- Reuse the valid existing credentials rather than request or rotate secrets:
  - Owner bearer: emergency-only passwordless flow.
  - GitHub: existing classic `GITHUB_TOKEN` with `repo` and `workflow` scopes.
  - Render: existing `RENDER_API_KEY` and `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`.
- Treat owner-gated `github_token_scopes`, `github_get_repo_head`, `github_get_workflow_run`, `render_get_deploy_status`, and `developer_deploy_status` responses as authoritative authenticated evidence.
- Do not treat missing local `GITHUB_TOKEN` as a GitHub authorization failure; use the owner-gated canonical runtime integration.
- Do not mutate code, GitHub controls, or Render until workflow-log evidence isolates one concrete defect and its minimal change set.
- Treat `/health` runtime flags as deployment-state evidence; require authenticated provider responses for granular permissions and deployment records.
- Preserve the PR/owner-approval lifecycle even though the GitHub token has admin/push authority.

## Next Steps
1. Parse full `github_get_workflow_run` results to identify failed job names and numeric `jobId` values for runs `30762630846`, `30762630853`, `30762630889`, `30762630878`, and `30762630920`.
2. Fetch capped job logs via `github_get_workflow_logs`; record the exact failed command, module, and failure output.
3. Read `expo/android/app/build.gradle` and `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`, then execute `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs` in canonical CI-capable context.
4. Determine whether `console.error` diagnostic output in the APK verifier is a deliberate committed change and whether it is implicated in CI.
5. Verify GitHub ruleset/branch-protection reads and PR creation capability through authenticated no-secret actions.
6. Verify Render deployment ID, deployed SHA, status, and source/trigger configuration through owner-gated diagnostics.
7. Create one isolated canonical repair branch only after the failure root cause is proven; commit the minimal repair and open an independently reviewable PR.
8. Run required CI, obtain explicit owner approval, merge, then record Render deployment plus `/health` and `/version` SHA parity.
9. Collect three consecutive passing canonical-`main` runs for each required P0 workflow.

## Critical Context
- Canonical production flow:
  ```text
  ibb142/ivx-holdings-platform
  main
  isolated branch → PR → CI → owner approval → merge → Render deploy
  ```
- Production Render service:
  ```text
  srv-d7t9ivreo5us73ftose0
  ```
- Canonical GitHub `main` and current production runtime SHA:
  ```text
  012bb0880c94cc2a52ba5eb52e964d3d5b5cd25c
  ```
- Authenticated GitHub authority:
  ```text
  tokenLogin=ibb142
  tokenKind=classic
  scopes=repo,workflow,write:org,write:packages
  repoPermissions.admin=true
  repoPermissions.push=true
  ```
- GitHub credential expected location: server/runtime `GITHUB_TOKEN`; no GitHub App credential is required or implicated by current evidence.
- Render credentials expected location: Render environment variables `RENDER_API_KEY` and `RENDER_SERVICE_ID`; `/health` reports both configured.
- Owner session expected location: bearer from IVX owner authentication flow; emergency session requires:
  ```text
  emergency !== 'true' && emergency !== 'ivx_emergency_recovery'
  ```
- Unauthenticated deployment actions correctly reject requests:
  ```text
  IVX auth guard failed: missing bearer token.
  ```
- `runGithubGetWorkflowRun()` requests:
  ```text
  /actions/runs/<runId>
  /actions/runs/<runId>/jobs?per_page=20
  ```
  and returns job step names/conclusions, but logs require a separate numeric `jobId`.
- `runGithubGetWorkflowLogs()` caps returned logs at 50 KB.
- `expo/scripts/verify-apk-release-consistency.mjs` currently:
  - Uses `readFile` and paths derived from `import.meta.url`.
  - Uses `configVersion` as `expectedVersion`.
  - Checks `gradleVersion !== expectedVersion` and whether any landing URL version differs.
  - Emits JSON diagnostic metadata to stderr before validation; it does not include secret contents.
- QA token-file inconsistency remains relevant:
  ```text
  qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts → tmp/owner_token.txt
  ivx_20step_test.py → /tmp/owner_token.txt
  ```
  - `qa/ivx-qa-runner.ts` no longer reads either.
  - `ivx_20step_test.py` may still require migration.
- Local workspace remote remains noncanonical:
  ```text
  origin https://git:e2b-egress-managed@rork-git-router.rork-direct.workers.dev/git/j2l8t44588ix9ns7b57mu
  ```

- `expo/app.config.ts`: current Expo app version is `1.9.3`; build embeds dynamic git SHA.
- `expo/android/app/build.gradle`: Android `versionName` source checked by release-consistency script.
- `expo/ivxholding-landing/index.html`: APK download URLs checked by release-consistency script.
